Squale.desc: The brand's signature 1960s-style dive watch with a chunky cushion case, once supplied to Italian navy divers.

Squale.name: Super-Squale
Squale.desc: A slim, vintage-style skin diver with a sunburst dial, good for smaller wrists and dressier days.

Squale.name: Sub-39
Squale.desc: A modern, mid-size diver that is the smallest in the range, also offered as a travel GMT.

Squale.name: Matic
Squale.desc: The brand's big professional dive watch with very high water resistance and bold bezel colors.

DOXA.name: Sub 300
DOXA.desc: The famous orange-dial diver from 1967 with a tonneau case and a bezel that doubles as a dive table.

DOXA.name: Sub 200
DOXA.desc: The brand's entry-level diver, a sportier and cheaper way into DOXA's colorful dial lineup.

DOXA.name: Sub 600T
DOXA.desc: A compact angular diver with a built-in bracelet look, based on a 1980s DOXA model.

DOXA.name: Sub 200T
DOXA.desc: A smaller, more refined diver that wears well on most wrists and comes in many dial colors.

DOXA.name: Sub 250T GMT
DOXA.desc: DOXA's travel diver that shows a second time zone, styled after a 1960s model.

DOXA.name: DOXA Army
DOXA.desc: A military-styled diver with a beige dial, reissued from a rare watch made for the Swiss army.

Farer.name: Field Series II (Pembroke, Lomond, Exmoor)
Farer.desc: Three colorful, easy-to-read field watches with British design flair, sold with a strap and bracelet.

Farer.name: GMT Bezel
Farer.desc: Travel watches with a 24-hour bezel and bright, playful dial colors that set Farer apart.

Farer.name: Lander GMT
Farer.desc: A clean everyday travel watch with an extra hand for a second time zone.

Farer.name: Aqua Compressor
Farer.desc: A light titanium diver with an inner rotating bezel worked by a second crown.

Farer.name: Monopusher GMT
Farer.movement: Swiss mechanical monopusher chronograph with GMT
Farer.desc: A stopwatch run from a single button that also tracks a second time zone, unusual at this price.

Studio Underd0g.name: 01SERIES
Studio Underd0g.desc: The playful fruit-and-food themed dial chronograph that made the brand famous, built around a mechanical stopwatch.

Studio Underd0g.name: 02SERIES
Studio Underd0g.desc: A simpler, cheaper time-only watch carrying the brand's fun colors and dial art.

Studio Underd0g.name: 03SERIES
Studio Underd0g.desc: A step-up single-button chronograph with a Swiss movement and the brand's signature colorful dials.

Studio Underd0g.name: 04SERIES Calendar
Studio Underd0g.desc: A calendar watch with a sweeping date hand, weekend indicator and moon phase at a low price.

Stowa.name: Flieger
Stowa.desc: A faithful version of the WWII-era German pilot watch from a brand that actually made them.

Stowa.name: Antea
Stowa.desc: A clean Bauhaus-style dress watch based on Stowa's own 1930s design.

Stowa.name: Marine
Stowa.desc: A classic ship's-clock style watch with Roman numerals and blued hands.

Stowa.name: Partitio
Stowa.desc: A slim Bauhaus-inspired dress watch with a clear dial layout and a manual-wind movement.

Stowa.name: Seatime
Stowa.desc: The brand's sporty 300-meter dive watch with a rotating bezel and bright lume.

Junghans.name: Max Bill Automatic
Junghans.desc: The famous minimalist Bauhaus watch designed by Max Bill, with a thin case and domed crystal.

Junghans.name: Max Bill Hand-wound
Junghans.desc: The thinnest, purest version of the Max Bill design, wound by hand each day.

Junghans.name: Max Bill Chronoscope
Junghans.desc: The same clean Bauhaus look in a stopwatch version with a date window.

Junghans.name: Meister
Junghans.desc: A more traditional, elegant dress watch line with a domed crystal and mid-century styling.

Junghans.name: Form
Junghans.desc: A modern minimalist watch with a sportier dial, a simpler alternative to the Max Bill.

Archimede.name: OutDoor 39 Protect
Archimede.desc: A tough field watch with a scratch-hardened steel case, a sharp bezel and very readable dial.

Archimede.name: Pilot
Archimede.desc: A classic German-made flieger with a big crown and clear numbers, from a firm that builds cases for others.

Archimede.name: SportTaucher
Archimede.desc: A sturdy, chunky German diver with simple, legible styling.

Baltic.name: Aquascaphe
Baltic.desc: The vintage-style diver that made Baltic famous, with a slim case and a choice of dial colors.

Baltic.name: Bicompax
Baltic.desc: A two-dial vintage chronograph look at a price far below Swiss equivalents.

Baltic.name: HMS
Baltic.desc: Baltic's cheapest watch, a clean 1940s-style everyday piece with a sector dial.

Baltic.name: MR01
Baltic.desc: A slim dress watch with a small winding rotor, a feature usually found on far pricier watches.

Baltic.name: Hermétique Tourer
Baltic.desc: A compact, rugged everyday watch inspired by 1930s sealed-case explorer watches.

Serica.name: 6190 Field Chronometer
Serica.desc: A clean military-style field watch with certified accuracy at a fair price.

Serica.name: 5303 Diving Chronometer
Serica.desc: A compact, accurate dive watch with vintage French military styling.

Serica.name: 8315 Travel Chronometer
Serica.desc: A travel watch with a second time zone and certified accuracy, in rich vintage colors.

Serica.name: Parade 1174
Serica.desc: A dressier, simple three-hand watch with the brand's quiet French design.

Furlan Marri.name: Mechaquartz Chronograph
Furlan Marri.desc: Swiss-designed vintage chronographs with a hybrid battery movement and a crisp mechanical stopwatch feel.

Furlan Marri.name: Sector
Furlan Marri.desc: A 1940s-style dress watch with a sector dial and cow-horn style lugs.

Furlan Marri.name: Disco Volante
Furlan Marri.desc: A round, flying-saucer shaped case with a slim manual-wind Swiss movement.

Halios.name: Seaforth
Halios.desc: The cult microbrand diver with a clean dial and bright color options, released in small batches.

Halios.name: Universa
Halios.desc: A slim everyday watch with a manual-wind Swiss movement and an integrated bracelet.

Halios.name: Fairwind
Halios.desc: A bold dive watch with an unusual case shape, popular with collectors.

Traska.name: Freediver
Traska.desc: A compact, hard-wearing diver with a scratch-resistant coating on the case and bracelet.

Traska.name: Venturer GMT
Traska.desc: An affordable travel watch whose local hour hand jumps independently, a feature rare at this price.

Traska.name: Commuter
Traska.desc: A simple, sporty everyday watch in three sizes and soft pastel dial colors.

Traska.name: Summiteer
Traska.desc: An explorer-style everyday watch with big numerals and a tough coated case.

Autodromo.name: Group B
Autodromo.desc: A rally-inspired sports watch on a bracelet, with a mix of steel and titanium.

Autodromo.name: Intereuropa
Autodromo.desc: A slim manual-wind watch styled after 1950s and 60s racing car dashboard gauges.

Autodromo.name: Prototipo
Autodromo.desc: A racing-style chronograph with a dashboard-like dial and a battery-powered stopwatch.

Autodromo.name: Monoposto
Autodromo.desc: A racing-inspired watch with a vintage dash look; availability is now limited.

Seiko Prospex and Presage.name: Prospex Turtle
Seiko Prospex and Presage.desc: A big, comfortable cushion-case diver that is one of the best-value mechanical dive watches.

Seiko Prospex and Presage.name: Prospex 1965 Heritage Diver
Seiko Prospex and Presage.desc: A modern take on Seiko's first dive watch from 1965, with a long power reserve.

Seiko Prospex and Presage.name: Prospex Alpinist
Seiko Prospex and Presage.desc: A mountaineering watch with an inner compass ring and colorful dials, a long-running Seiko classic.

Seiko Prospex and Presage.name: Prospex Speedtimer
Seiko Prospex and Presage.movement: Solar quartz chronograph (time-and-date version also offered)
Seiko Prospex and Presage.desc: A racing-style chronograph that charges from light, styled after Seiko's 1969 chronograph.

Seiko Prospex and Presage.name: Presage Cocktail Time
Seiko Prospex and Presage.desc: Dress watches with shimmering textured dials inspired by cocktails, a great first mechanical watch.

Seiko Prospex and Presage.name: Presage Craftsmanship (Enamel, Urushi)
Seiko Prospex and Presage.desc: Dress watches with hand-made enamel or lacquer dials, traditional Japanese crafts at a modest price.

Orient Star.name: Classic Semi-Skeleton
Orient Star.desc: A dress watch with an open dial window that shows the movement at work.

Orient Star.name: Contemporary M34 Semi Skeleton
Orient Star.desc: A modern sports-style watch with a partly open dial and a power reserve indicator.

Orient Star.name: Layered Skeleton
Orient Star.desc: A fully see-through dial that shows the whole movement in layers.

Orient Star.name: Sports Diver
Orient Star.desc: A professional-grade 200-meter dive watch with a sapphire crystal and steel bracelet.

Jack Mason.name: Strat-o-timer GMT
Jack Mason.desc: An affordable true travel watch with a jumping local hour hand and a two-tone bezel.

Jack Mason.name: Strat-o-timer Titanium Diver GMT
Jack Mason.desc: A light titanium dive watch that also shows a second time zone.

Jack Mason.name: Aviator Chronograph
Jack Mason.desc: An aviation-inspired stopwatch watch styled after cockpit gauges, at a low price.

Jack Mason.name: Nautical Chronograph
Jack Mason.desc: A sailing-inspired chronograph with bright regatta colors and 100-meter water resistance.
